name: haus-bench
description: Benchmarks: haus against JSON (size, tokens, TypeScript speed) on real data

scripts.all: pnpm run prepare-haus && pnpm run fetch && pnpm run convert && pnpm run tokens && pnpm run speed && pnpm run report
scripts.smoke: pnpm run prepare-haus && pnpm run fetch && node convert.ts --limit 40 && node tokens.ts --tokenizers o200k && node --expose-gc speed.bench.ts --quick && pnpm run report
